proposals.action_title: Upload 50 Text-Only Meme Stickers on Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble is registered but has 0 listings. Text-based sticker designs require 0 image generation budget, bypass current AI bottlenecks, render perfectly on mobile, and convert fast on trending pop-culture/workplace humor.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 50 SVG text layouts on Termux using a Python script with open-source Google Fonts (e.g., impact, permanent marker) and push them to GitHub.

proposals.action_title: Publish First KDP Coloring Book using Runware PAYG
proposals.why_this_works_now: Unlocks the 'produce_coloring_book' priority. Spending 2-3 EUR of the 20 EUR budget on Runware (FLUX-schnell) bypasses free API limits, delivering 40+ high-quality, ultra-crisp vector-like coloring pages that actually sell.
proposals.first_action_today: Configure Runware API key in GitHub Actions secrets and run a test batch of 5 coloring book pages to verify quality.

proposals.action_title: Upload 5 Niche French Logbooks on KDP
proposals.why_this_works_now: Low-content logbooks (e.g., 'Carnet de Pêche', 'Suivi de Ruche') have high demand in France with low competition. Interior PDFs are 100% text/tables, easily generated using ReportLab on Termux with zero image API dependencies.
proposals.first_action_today: Write a Python script on Termux to output a structured 100-page PDF interior for a specific French outdoor hobby.

proposals.action_title: Publish 3 Parametric 3D Printing Files on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D is highly receptive to functional, parametric designs (e.g., customized brackets, storage organizers, Gridfinity mods). Using OpenSCAD via CLI on Termux allows programmatic generation of STL files without a high-end PC.
proposals.first_action_today: Finalize one parametric organizer design in OpenSCAD on Termux, render the STL, and set up the Cults3D seller profile.

proposals.action_title: Bundle and Upload 2D Game Asset Pack on Itch.io
proposals.why_this_works_now: Itch.io allows immediate publishing of digital assets with no upfront fees. Micro gamedev assets (UI buttons, retro icons, pixel art tilesets) can be generated using Together AI's free tier (FLUX-schnell) and packaged on Termux.
proposals.first_action_today: Run a test generation of a 16x16 icon sheet using Together AI free tier and slice it into individual PNGs via Python PIL.
